greeting: A calm Sunday, Dan — the review with Mike is done and the afternoon's clear before you fly to Portland tomorrow.

needsAttention.title: Fly to Portland midday
needsAttention.detail: On your calendar: MX 1004 leaves Tampa at 12:20 PM Monday. The St. Pete place checks out the same day, so packing and the ride to TPA are tonight-and-morning work.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas is the thinnest rental of the year, and this has been open in Todoist since mid-September. A refundable hold now costs nothing and closes the risk.

needsAttention.title: December trip for the four kids
needsAttention.detail: Book-by is Oct 15 for the Dec 13–Jan 2 window. Passports land in November, so a domestic shortlist is the safe default — picking one lets the Pathfinder drive and the rotation fall into place.

needsAttention.title: Finish the ICGN panel bio
needsAttention.detail: Drew sent notes back on Sept 28 about making the LinkedIn announcement sparkle; the bio ICGN needs for the Toronto panel in November still has to go out.

flagged.title: Apple account sign-in alert
flagged.detail: An 'action required' notice says a new Apple Account signed in to your iPhone 17e and AppleCare coverage is at stake — worth confirming it's really you before clicking.

flagged.title: Amex October statement

flagged.title: NACD New England — Oct 28
flagged.detail: Josh Broder is rallying the group to invite their networks to the Maine Visionaries event; a governance room worth being seen in.
